+Default ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` setting changed from ``None`` to ``0o644``
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+Without a consistent umask, permissions for a file uploaded to
+``FileSystemStorage`` could be inconsistent depending on the type of storage
+used to temporarily store the file data during upload (either ``MemoryUploadedFile``
+or ``TemporaryUploadedFile``). To ensure consistent file permissions, the
+default for :setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` is now ``0o644``.
+
